title: Ahsoka Tano
description: Although she left the Jedi Order behind, the overriding need to help others never left Ahsoka Tano. As a respected leader, warrior, and someone adept with the light side of the Force, she always held the responsibility of considerable power. She fought with the Rebel Alliance and served as an agent known as Fulcrum until she was exiled to the world of Malachor. After she found her way back, she set her sights on protecting the galaxy from the threat of Grand Admiral Thrawn, even if it meant risking her standing with the leadership of the New Republic—and even her life.
